no_claim: A bound score record. It establishes no stability, translation or expression benefit.
The two scores are incommensurable and are deliberately not combined.
No floor is selected, no gate requirement is satisfied, and no candidate was designed or scored.

records.composite_blocked_reason: Incommensurable units across components and no selected floor; no weighting is justified.

exclusions.reason: The published STRAND model is not applicable to RNAfold-derived features. configs/strand_rnafold_agreement_criterion_v1 returned feature_level_compatible false, output_level_equivalent false and outcome rejected, so the unchanged published coefficients may not be applied to this sequence.

scores.interpretation: A separately named refit, NOT the published STRAND model, which this project's frozen agreement criterion rejected for RNAfold-derived features. The calibration is unvalidated: it has no independent evaluation against held-out measurements. EXTRAPOLATION: GC = 64.4395 lies outside the training range [39.4397, 60.2371] It predicts in-solution half-life of purified RNA in buffer, whereas the planned assay measures in-cell mRNA decay by RT-qPCR, so the two are different quantities. Every uridine in the assayed molecule is N1-methylpseudouridine, which neither the folding engine nor the calibration represents. This number ranks nothing and establishes no stability benefit.
